title: Left-unit coherence under composition
statement: Let \(C,D,E\) be monoidal categories and \(F:C\to D\), \(G:D\to E\) functors. Let \(d_F(X,Y):F(X\otimes Y)\simeq FX\otimes FY\) and \(d_G(U,V):G(U\otimes V)\simeq GU\otimes GV\) be families of isomorphisms, with \(d_G\) natural in its first variable. Let \(e_F:F1_C\simeq1_D\), \(e_G:G1_D\simeq1_E\). Suppose each family and its unit satisfy the left-unit equation \(d(1,X);(e\mathbin{\triangleright}HX);\lambda_{HX}=H(\lambda_X)\). Then the composite family \(G(d_F(X,Y));d_G(FX,FY)\), with unit \(G(e_F);e_G\), satisfies the left-unit equation for \(F;G\). Here semicolon denotes composition in application order; no other naturality or associativity axiom is required.

proof.text: Expand the composite unit using functoriality of right whiskering. Naturality of dG in its first variable moves G(eF) to the left of dG. Apply the left-unit law for G. Combine the three G-images by functoriality and apply the left-unit law for F.

theorem composite_left_unit
    {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D] [MonoidalCategory E]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E)
    (dF : ∀ X Y : C, F.obj (X ⊗ Y) ≅ F.obj X ⊗ F.obj Y)
    (dG : ∀ X Y : D, G.obj (X ⊗ Y) ≅ G.obj X ⊗ G.obj Y)
    (hdG : ∀ {X Y : D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (Z : D),
      G.map (f ▷ Z) ≫ (dG Y Z).hom =
        (dG X Z).hom ≫ (G.map f ▷ G.obj Z))
    (eF : F.obj (𝟙_ C) ≅ 𝟙_ D) (eG : G.obj (𝟙_ D) ≅ 𝟙_ E)
    (hF : ∀ X, (dF (𝟙_ C) X).hom ≫ eF.hom ▷ F.obj X ≫
      (λ_ (F.obj X)).hom = F.map (λ_ X).hom)
    (hG : ∀ X, (dG (𝟙_ D) X).hom ≫ eG.hom ▷ G.obj X ≫
      (λ_ (G.obj X)).hom = G.map (λ_ X).hom)
    (X : C) :
    G.map ((dF (𝟙_ C) X).hom) ≫ (dG (F.obj (𝟙_ C)) (F.obj X)).hom ≫
        (G.map eF.hom ≫ eG.hom) ▷ G.obj (F.obj X) ≫
        (λ_ (G.obj (F.obj X))).hom = G.map (F.map (λ_ X).hom)
